This '''group''' was a [[Band/Legends|band]] comprised of three musicians: a [[Unidentified male string instrument player|string player]], a [[Unidentified male keyboardist|keyboardist]], and a [[Unidentified female percussionist|percussionist]]. They were all professionally pretty and wore colorful garments with wild diversity, like space vagabonds.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> they were busking for [[credcoin]]s at an open market near the [[Old Kura City Courthouse Plaza]] in [[Kura City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. [[Voort saBinring]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], approached them with an offer. He gave them a [[credcard]] containing a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for playing loud music that he could dance to, which the band agreed to. They played a loud rendition of ''[[Torrid Yavin]]'', an anthem for the rebuilding of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. saBinring began dancing to the music and slowly gained an enthusiastic audience, which was all part of his plan to gather witnesses as he and the Wraiths exposed the criminal activities of Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], who was in the vicinity.<ref name="MK" />
